results.summary:
Release path is in: `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `docs/releasing.md`, `test/release.test.js`. Draft PR #58 on branch kb/53, based on main.

THE WORKFLOW. Trigger is `push: tags: ["v*"]` and nothing else — no cron, no workflow_dispatch, so there is no way to publish except by tagging. `concurrency: release-${{ github.ref }}` with cancel-in-progress false.

Job `publish` (permissions contents:read + id-token:write, timeout 15m): checkout → setup-node 22 with registry-url https://registry.npmjs.org → `npm run lint` → `npm test` under TZ=UTC → `npm test` under TZ=America/New_York (same pair test.yml runs) → step id `gate` (compares "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" with package.json version; on mismatch ::error:: naming both numbers AND the fix, exit 1; on match emits output `version`) → step id `preflight` (NPM_TOKEN present ⇒ ready=true, absent ⇒ ready=false plus a ::notice:: naming `npm token create --read-only=false` and `gh secret set NPM_TOKEN`, exit 0 — a fork or an unconfigured repo never goes red) → step id `publish`, `if: steps.preflight.outputs.ready == 'true'`, runs `npm publish --provenance --access public` with NODE_AUTH_TOKEN from the secret and emits output `published=true`.

Job `verify` (needs: publish, `if: needs.publish.outputs.published == 'true'`, timeout 10m): setup-node ONLY — deliberately NO actions/checkout, so nothing from this repo is on that runner. Runs `npx -y hkb@$VERSION version`, retrying 10 times 30s apart for registry propagation, matches the output on the TAIL of the line (`*" ${VERSION}"`) so hkb@1.4.10 cannot pass for a 1.4.1 release, then runs `npx -y hkb@$VERSION help`. Gives up after ~5 min with an ::error::. THIS JOB IS THE END-TO-END PROOF that `npx hkb` works for a stranger.

FOR #55: the smoke test in .github/workflows/test.yml is the pre-publish counterpart to this — release.yml verifies the REGISTRY copy after publishing, #55 should verify the PACKED copy before it (npm pack → install the tarball in a clean dir → run the bin). Do not duplicate the registry check; it lives here. Note #52's residual risk: nobody has yet installed a packed hkb tarball and run it, so #55 is the first place that actually happens.

TESTS (test/release.test.js, 20 tests, style of test/actions.test.js — parsed with test/yaml.js, never regexed). Beyond the structural assertions, the two steps with real logic are EXECUTED: a `runStep()` helper runs a step's `run:` under `bash -e` in a scratch cwd with $GITHUB_OUTPUT wired up and stub executables prepended to PATH. That covers the gate (match / mismatch), the preflight (secret present / absent, and that the token is never echoed), and the retry loop against a stub `npx` that 404s N times plus a no-op `sleep` — first-try success, success after 4 propagation failures, the bounded give-up (exactly 10 calls), a wrong-version answer, and the 1.4.10-vs-1.4.1 case. Reuse `runStep()` if #55 needs to exercise shell.

SCOPE NOTE: test/release.test.js is outside this task's declared kb.paths (.github/workflows/release.yml, docs/), but the "done when" requires tests in the style of test/actions.test.js. No other node on the track declares test/.
